global_identity.color_palette: Keep the reference color logic (bright warm festive photo, black and fuchsia text, solid fuchsia graphic accents, white text on fuchsia bar) mapped to the brand: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E for the key headline words, icon circles, pill labels and bottom bar; bottle black #0E0E10 for the second headline line and script; dark charcoal #2A2A2E for small body text; white #FFFFFF; pale blush pink #FBE3EE and bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 in background bokeh. global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement Christmas ad: realistic cozy holiday bedroom photo with a decorated tree, a confident woman holding the black-and-fuchsia bottle, the bottle as hero on the right, clean fuchsia icon modules and a rounded fuchsia bottom bar.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and festive; soft warm daylight mixed with fairy-light bokeh, believable and natural.
global_identity.graphic_language: Solid fuchsia circles with thin-line white icons, rounded fuchsia pill labels and bottom bar, handwritten script accents with small hearts, a round gold seal, soft pink bokeh, gifts with red ribbons.
global_identity.text_typography: Exactly the reference typography: opening line in an elegant black handwritten brush script, slightly tilted upward; key words in a huge ultra-bold geometric sans-serif, all uppercase (Montserrat Black look), fuchsia; second headline line in a bold geometric sans-serif, all uppercase, black, about 40% the height of the key words; subtitle in a clean regular sans-serif (Poppins Regular look), sentence case, dark charcoal, with a small solid fuchsia heart; icon labels in the same regular sans, sentence case, dark charcoal, small; left emotional note in a casual white handwritten script with a small outline heart; gift tag note in a black handwritten script; pill labels and bottom bar in white uppercase medium sans-serif with one bold word.

creative_objective: Recreate the user's winning Christmas ad with the same composition, blocks, hierarchy and typography, with a new model, and a headline that turns her biggest pain (jeans that stay loose at the back) into the Christmas wish: that her jeans finally fit her curves.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: First: the woman on the left and the huge fuchsia headline words top right. Second: the big bottle hero on the right and the black second headline line. Third: the four fuchsia icon rows, the DÍA 1 / MES 3 panel, the handwritten notes and the fuchsia bottom bar.
art_direction.composition_style: Asymmetric split: the woman occupies the left half, the text stack and product occupy the right half; the bottom bar spans the lower center-right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Tight right column: headline stack at top, icon list below it on the left side of the right half, bottle to its right, small two-photo panel under the icon list, gift box in the bottom-right corner, bar at the very bottom. Breathing room around the headline.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Warm soft indoor daylight, golden fairy-light bokeh from the tree, shallow depth of field on the background, natural soft shadows under the woman and the bottle, realistic skin texture.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square festive ad. Left half (x 0-50%): a woman kneeling on a white fluffy rug, shown from behind in three-quarter profile facing right, torso turned and looking over her shoulder at the camera, wearing a red-and-white Santa hat, a red fitted top, white fitted knit shorts with a small red bow, red-and-white Nordic knee socks; her raised hand holds the product bottle next to her face (upper center, x 38-50%, y 14-32%). Behind her on the left: a decorated Christmas tree with warm lights and red/gold ornaments, wrapped gifts at its base. Top right (x 45-97%, y 4-30%): headline stack: black script line, huge fuchsia uppercase words, black uppercase line, two-line subtitle. Middle right column (x 52-72%, y 34-66%): four rows, each a solid fuchsia circle with a white thin-line icon and a two-line label to its right. Right (x 72-97%, y 34-78%): large standing product bottle with a round gold PREMIUM seal overlapping its upper right, and a few pink capsules lying on the rug in front. Left middle (x 2-22%, y 43-60%): white handwritten note over the tree area. Lower middle (x 50-70%, y 66-86%): small panel of two rounded-corner photos side by side with fuchsia pill labels on top and a white curved arrow between them. Bottom right corner (x 80-100%, y 80-98%): wrapped gift box with red ribbon and a hanging kraft tag with handwritten text. Bottom center (x 38-84%, y 93-99%): rounded fuchsia pill bar with white uppercase text. No price, no CTA button, no logo.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium Christmas lifestyle supplement ad, photorealistic. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. The product is a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; its black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. SCENE: a cozy bright bedroom at Christmas; on the left a decorated Christmas tree with warm golden fairy lights and red and gold ornaments, wrapped gifts with red ribbons at its base; a soft cream wall with blush-pink bokeh on the right; a thick white fluffy rug on the floor; warm soft daylight. LEFT HALF: a Colombian woman around 27 with warm tan skin, long wavy dark-brown hair with soft caramel highlights, natural makeup and a warm confident smile, wearing a red-and-white Santa hat, a red fitted top, white fitted ribbed knit shorts with a small red bow on the side, and red-and-white Nordic knee socks; she kneels on the rug seen from behind in three-quarter profile facing right, torso turned, looking over her shoulder at the camera, showing natural athletic curves in glutes and thighs, tasteful and not explicit; her raised hand holds the product bottle next to her face with the label facing the camera. Real skin texture, natural light. TOP RIGHT: the headline stack aligned left inside the right half: a black handwritten brush-script line slightly tilted upward, below it huge ultra-bold uppercase geometric sans-serif words in fuchsia #E6177F, below it a bold uppercase black line, below it a two-line regular sans-serif subtitle in dark charcoal ending with a small fuchsia heart. MIDDLE RIGHT COLUMN: four stacked rows, each a solid fuchsia circle with a thin-line white icon (1 a curvy peach silhouette, 2 a leg silhouette, 3 a lightning bolt, 4 a leaf) and a small two-line dark charcoal label to its right. RIGHT SIDE: the same product bottle shown large and standing on the rug, sharp and identical to the photo, slightly angled, with a round metallic gold seal with small stars reading PREMIUM overlapping its upper right shoulder, and a few glossy pink capsules lying on the rug in front of it. LEFT MIDDLE over the tree area: a short white handwritten script note in four short lines with a small outline heart. LOWER MIDDLE under the icon list: a small panel of two rounded-corner photos side by side showing the same woman from behind at hip level in fitted shorts (left in grey shorts, right in pink shorts, a natural subtle difference), each with a small fuchsia pill label on top with white uppercase text, and a white curved arrow between them. BOTTOM RIGHT CORNER: a wrapped gift box with a red satin ribbon and a hanging kraft paper tag with black handwritten text. BOTTOM CENTER: a rounded fuchsia pill bar with white uppercase text and a small white heart. The top right corner stays as clean background (no logo). Render all text exactly as given, sharp and legible on a phone. Do not add CTA buttons, price badges, extra benefit lists, extra icons, trust badges, extra rating stars, discount labels, testimonials, logos or any extra text.
